name: Peach - Submission Build
author: Cal_Hemingway
description: READ ME READ ME READ ME Mechanics: +HUD: Lives, Coin Counter.  +Side-Scrolling Movement and Camera. +Animated Character. +Spinning interactable coins. +Platforming Elements. +Breakable Brick blocks with randomly generated coin count. +Brick breaking effects/particles. +Interactable Lucky Blocks either holding 1-Up or Red-Mushrooms. +Lucky block efffects and particles. +Moving Mushrooms. +Red Mushroom. +1-Up mushroom. +1-Up sprite on pick-up. +Red Mushroom sprite on Pick-Up. +Moving Goomba. +Goomba Animations. +Goomba damaging player. +Player damaging Goomba. +Player bouncing off Goomba's head. +Mushroom(s) Kills Goomba +Thwomp moving up and down. +Thwomp kills player when slamming down. +Thwomp effects and particles. +Thwomp attack Indicator. +Wall Jumping Mechanics (Jump against wall then jump in opposite direction. +Player death. +Player respawn. +Level reset at 0 lives. +Level reset when timer hits 0.
